G'oya

Har bir shahar bitta guruh, har bir guruhda nechta qator borligi kerak: GROUP BY city va COUNT(*). Shahri noma'lum mijozlar uchun alohida ish qilish shart emas. GROUP BY barcha NULL larni o'zi bitta guruhga yig'adi.

Yechim

SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM customers
GROUP BY city

Namunada Toshkent 3, Samarqand 2, shahri ko'rsatilmagan Malika esa NULL guruhda 1.

Tuzoqlar

COUNT(city) faqat city si NULL bo'lmagan qatorlarni sanaydi. NULL guruh natijada qoladi, lekin uning soni 0 bo'lib chiqadi va Malika sanalmaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT city, COUNT(city) AS customers
FROM customers
GROUP BY city

WHERE city IS NOT NULL qo'shish ham xato: shart shahri noma'lum mijozlarni ham sanashni so'rayapti.

COUNT(DISTINCT name) bilan sanamang. Bir shaharda ikkita Aziz bo'lsa, bu ikki xil odam. Shahar nomini LOWER bilan bir xillashtirish ham kerak emas: shartga ko'ra 'Buxoro' va 'buxoro' alohida guruhlar.
